stories.title: OpenAI launches GPT-6 Sol and Luna, boasting lower cost and fewer mistakes
stories.simple_summary: OpenAI released two new AI assistants called Sol and Luna that work better and cost less money to use than their older versions.
stories.why_it_matters: If you use AI tools for your small business, these cheaper options could save you money on your monthly bills.

stories.title: Anthropic releases Opus 5.5 with lower prices and Fable-level performance
stories.simple_summary: Anthropic released a new AI assistant called Opus 5.5 that works really well and costs less than before.
stories.why_it_matters: Similar to the OpenAI news above — cheaper AI tools might help small business owners save money if they use these services.

stories.title: Trump says US is officially renaming AI ‘super intelligence’
stories.simple_summary: President Trump said the US is renaming 'artificial intelligence' to 'super intelligence' because he thinks the word 'artificial' makes it sound fake.
stories.why_it_matters: This is just a name change that doesn't affect how AI actually works or what it can do for you.

stories.title: AstroForge is putting AI in command of its next spacecraft
stories.simple_summary: A space company is using AI to control a spacecraft instead of having humans operate it from Earth.
stories.why_it_matters: This mostly matters to space engineers and investors — nothing you need to act on.

stories.title: Five AI safety sessions every founder should have on their TechCrunch Disrupt 2026 agenda
stories.simple_summary: A tech conference is offering sessions where experts discuss how to use AI safely and responsibly.
stories.why_it_matters: This is for people attending a specific conference in 2026 — not relevant unless you're planning to go.

stories.title: TechCrunch Disrupt 2026: Aaron Edsinger brings Hello Robot’s Stretch 4 to life onstage
stories.simple_summary: A robotics company is showing off its latest robot at a tech conference.
stories.why_it_matters: This is a conference announcement — mostly just for people interested in attending that specific event.

stories.title: Exhibit tables added: One last chance to showcase your startup at TechCrunch Disrupt 2026
stories.simple_summary: A big tech conference is giving companies one more week to book a booth where they can show off their products.
stories.why_it_matters: Only relevant if you run a tech startup and want to exhibit at this conference.

stories.title: 4 days to save up to $200: Reason 2 of 5 to be at TechCrunch Disrupt 2026
stories.simple_summary: A tech conference is reminding people they have a few days left to buy discounted tickets.
stories.why_it_matters: Only matters if you were already planning to attend this conference.

stories.title: Everyone can find a reason to dislike data center construction
stories.simple_summary: Building large computer centers for AI has become controversial in Pennsylvania, with neighbors and communities raising concerns about the construction.
stories.why_it_matters: This mostly matters to investors and people in Pennsylvania — nothing you need to act on unless you live near a proposed data center.

stories.title: Nscale’s IPO will test Wall Street’s appetite for concentrated AI bets once again
stories.simple_summary: A British company that builds computer centers for AI companies is going public (selling stock), and many of its customers are giant tech companies.
stories.why_it_matters: This mostly matters to stock investors — nothing you need to act on.

stories.title: Meta patches Muse exploit that let attackers control the AI agent
stories.simple_summary: Meta (Facebook's owner) fixed a security bug in its AI assistant that could have let hackers take control of it.
stories.why_it_matters: If you use Meta's Muse AI tool, the company fixed a problem that could have let someone hack it — update your app to stay safe.

stories.title: The man who built Apple’s stores doesn’t buy Silicon Valley’s bet on AI shopping
stories.simple_summary: The person who designed Apple's retail stores says that having real people helping customers is more important than relying only on AI.
stories.why_it_matters: This suggests that for shopping experiences, hiring good employees may still matter more than high-tech AI — useful to remember if you own a small business.
